classificationRules: automated_real_interaction: a browser test reaches the action through the control a person sees (click, tap, keyboard, navigation) AND asserts the user-observable outcome; mutating actions must also assert persistence after reload/navigation.

Playwright fill() into a plain visible text/tel/number/textarea field counts as real typing (fill() requires the element to be visible, enabled and editable, and focuses it). fill() does NOT count for native-picker controls (date, select, file) or any control whose visible affordance is a different element from the DOM control (e.g. the opacity-0 date input under the due-date display).

automated_partial: the test uses page.goto to skip the in-app entry point, fill() on a picker control, page.request/API calls, page.evaluate fetch, stubs/mocks, component tests with fireEvent, or asserts only rendering (screenshots, axe scans, text presence).

A test that is test.skip()-ed or test.fixme()-ed in a project does not count for that project; a test.fail()-annotated (expected-failure) test never counts as coverage. `npm run coverage:journeys` enforces this: every titled reference must be a test Playwright itself registers (`playwright test --list`), and each claimed project needs a real test that its AST shows is not skipped, fixme'd or expected to fail there; a condition it cannot evaluate does not count. With `--results <playwright-json>` it also checks the claims against an actual run (CI does this for the @critical run).
tests/ux-audit specs run in the CI ux-audit job, which is report-gated (scripts/ux-audit.ts), not a per-test exit-code gate; they are credited but called out as such.

findings.summary: 'Tandai terlambat' on a DUE invoice with no past due date stores OVERDUE, but the chip immediately re-derives to Terkirim (deriveInvoiceDisplayStatus). The person asked for 'Terlambat' and sees 'Terkirim'.
findings.status: open: needs a product decision (keep manual overdue, hide the action without a past due date, or show stored OVERDUE)

findings.summary: Clicking/tapping the visible empty due-date field does not open the date picker (opacity-0 native input; Chromium opens only from the invisible icon edge). Production report 2026-10-03.
findings.status: fixed: PR #26 (merge b51fba1, into staging 2026-10-04; not yet on main/Production). Regression: e2e/invoices/due-date-integrity.spec.ts picker tests (INV-DUE-02). Real Android/iOS verification (MAN-DUE-01) still pending.

findings.summary: Desktop keyboard entry of a due date saves a year-0002 date as soon as the first year digit is typed (Chromium emits 0002-mm-dd, the DateField commits every change, and PATCH /api/invoices/:id returns 200). The owner's invoice detail page then throws 'Expected an ISO yyyy-mm-dd date, received: 2-mm-dd' into the route error boundary ('Gagal memuat.') on every load, so the field that could fix it is unreachable. The list, Beranda, deal detail, public page and public PDF still render.
findings.status: fixed: PR #26 (merge b51fba1, into staging 2026-10-04; not yet on main/Production). Regression: e2e/invoices/due-date-integrity.spec.ts keyboard, legacy-row and API tests (INV-DUE-04). The read-only Production count of out-of-range Invoice.dueDate / Deal.deadline has not been run (needs Chris); legacy rows elsewhere (list, Beranda, public page, PDF) still render the raw date.

findings.summary: Blocked-popup detection never works: invoice detail (sendWhatsApp) and the Beranda queue (openReminder) call window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') and treat a null return as 'blocked', but the HTML spec makes window.open() return null whenever noopener is set. So after WhatsApp opens normally, a 'Buka WhatsApp' fallback link still appears (a second click opens a second chat), and a really blocked popup is indistinguishable.
findings.status: fixed: PR #29 (merge ac53043, into staging 2026-10-07; not yet on main/Production). Both surfaces now open a blank tab on the click (src/lib/whatsapp-popup.ts), cut its opener and navigate it without a Referer, so null from window.open means a real block. Regression: e2e/home/follow-up-queue.spec.ts and e2e/invoices/overdue-invoice.spec.ts (popup opened -> one tab, no fallback), e2e/whatsapp/popup-blocker.spec.ts (real Chromium blocker -> fallback, no tab). Real phones and the WhatsApp app stay MAN-WA-01

findings.summary: Beranda 'Kirim pengingat' always rotated the invoice's share token (POST /api/invoices/:id/share -> createOrRegenerateShare), while invoice detail reuses the active link. A link the brand already received returned 404 after a reminder from Beranda (verified 2026-10-04 with a session-less context).
findings.status: fixed: PR #30 (merge e498ad5, into staging 2026-10-07; not yet on main/Production). Chris's decision 2026-10-07: a reminder reuses a usable active link and creates one only when none is usable; only explicit Regenerate rotates. Beranda now calls POST /api/invoices/:id/share/ensure (ensureShare in src/lib/invoice-share.ts): reuse when unexpired and the path is recoverable, without extending the expiry. Regression: e2e/invoices/reminder-share-link.spec.ts (reuse, repeat, no share, expired, Regenerate still rotates) and src/lib/invoice-share.test.ts.

findings.summary: The invoice list groups and labels by stored status, while Beranda and invoice detail derive OVERDUE from the Jakarta due date. A SENT invoice due yesterday shows 'Telat 1 hari' on Beranda and 'Terlambat' on detail, but sits under Terkirim with a TERKIRIM chip in the list.
findings.status: open: needs a product decision; related to FIND-01 (stored vs derived OVERDUE). No test asserts the list's grouping of this state.

findings.summary: Invoice detail treated an expired share as active: the share section read 'Tautan aktif sampai <past date>.' and Kirim lewat WhatsApp / Kirim pengingat sent that expired link, which shows the recipient 'Tautan ini sudah tidak berlaku.' Cause: getShareState reported any existing row as active, and sendWhatsApp reused the loaded link without checking expiry. Verified 2026-10-07 on the expired-share fixture (expiry 1 Jan 2020).
findings.status: fixed: fix/expired-share-reminder-2026-10-08 (PR into staging, open, not merged; not on main/Production). Chris's decision 2026-10-07: an expired share is never shown as active and never sent; invoice detail sends through the same ensure-share contract as Beranda. getShareState now reports inactive / active / expired (one expiry rule, no path for an expired share); invoice detail shows an expired state with Buat tautan baru (ID + EN) and its send asks POST /api/invoices/:id/share/ensure. Regression: e2e/invoices/expired-share.spec.ts, src/lib/invoice-share.test.ts, invoice-detail-client.test.tsx.
